overall: Committee violated the OML by not notifying the AG within 30 days that it had complied with OML 2022-34 minutes order; the AG declined to review the complaint about failing to respond to the first complaint.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Committee failed to comply with the OML 2022-34 order to amend the July 19, 2021 minutes to list documents used at that meeting.
allegations.key_passage: However, because the Committee did not notify the Attorney General that it had done so within 30 days of the date of the order (and indeed did not amend the minutes within 30 days of the date of the order), we find the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law as alleged.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Committee failed to respond to the first complaint.
allegations.key_passage: our office would decline to review complaints alleging that public bodies in Everett have failed to review or respond to prior complaints.
